math_cards: Macroscopic pressure, volume, and absolute temperature are coupled by microscopic molecular collision kinetics
ΔU = Q + W_on = n · C_v · ΔT
Mechanical boundary work done by an advancing piston directly pumps thermal internal energy into the gas
P · V^γ = const,  T · V^(γ - 1) = const
Without heat loss (Q = 0), rapid compression produces a steep pressure and temperature spike governed by gamma
desktop_mission.voice_math: The core physics: the ideal gas equation of state, the first law of thermodynamics, and adiabatic compression work.

math_steps.note: Rapid volume reduction raises absolute temperature inversely with volume ratio raised to gamma minus one

math_steps.note: Gas pressure surges dramatically as molecules bounce with higher root-mean-square kinetic velocities

math_steps.formula: W_on = -∫ P dV = n · C_v · (T - T_0)
